outcome: performance of glucose testing at six-weeks postpartum
rates of annual follow-up postpartum glucose testing by GPs
adherence to healthy lifestyle (physical activity, fruit intake, vegetable intake)
cohort: The study included 197 women with a history of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) and 74 of their general practitioners (GPs).
finding: Despite high attendance for six-weeks postpartum glucose testing, the study observed low rates of longer-term follow-up glucose testing and suboptimal adherence to healthy lifestyle among women with a history of GDM.
followup_time: Up to three consecutive years for glucose testing and approximately 3-4 years for lifestyle assessment.
cross-section timing: Hospital records from 2011-2012 for early postpartum data; surveys among women and GPs were conducted around 2015.
